description: Lab environment for the PowerShell Zero-to-Hero course in the lab.graydaycafe.com domain: GDC-DC (Server Core domain controller) and GDC-Cli (Windows 11 client with RSAT, PowerShell 7, Sysinternals and VS Code). An optional GDC-Web member server (IIS and file shares) supports remoting and multiple-services demos.
summary: Two or three VMs: Server Core domain controller, domain-joined Windows 11 client, and an optional web/file member server.
